messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: SERVICE=redwood-inference-hosted, SEV=p99-latency, REGION=eu-west-1, metric=p99_latency_ms, value=1340ms, threshold=800ms — page fired (PD: PD-8742)
Alex: acked — oncall here, grabbing console. tagging @Maya and @Raj for runtime checks
Maya: looking at dashboards now — seeing gradual tail increase on tokenized requests, KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 76% in last 20m
Raj: any rollout or model change? deploy bot show?
Alex: no recent deploys to hosted; last infra change was autoscaler tweak 3h ago (not related but noted)
Sasha: I see a spike in batch latency traces — a handful of large requests are holding GPU hotpath, queues backed up. possibly a hotkey or long-seq generation ramp
Maya: running quick query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups[5m]))` -> ~0.76. checking hotkey histogram: top 5 keys account for 18% of requests
Raj: if hotkeys, we can enable per-key rate-limit fallback to smaller batch path. pushing a manual routing rule would help immediate tail
Alex: can you push a temporary routing override to route requests with header `X-Client=high` to fallback model variant? low-risk?
Raj: doing `kubectl apply -f` now — will route matching header -> variant-small-batch for 10m. patch: `apiVersion: routing/v1\nkind: RouteOverride\n...`
incident-bot: deployment job started: route-override-applied by Raj (job id job-99231)
Maya: after override, KV hit rate recovering slowly, p99 dropped from 1340ms -> 920ms in first 2m. still above threshold but trending down
Tony: support: we have a customer (acct: AcmeCorp) opened a ticket about timeouts in EU. ETA on mitigation? they asked if this is a region outage
Alex: reply to customer: "We’re investigating increased inference latency in eu-west-1 and have applied routing mitigations. No region-wide outage; we expect improvement in ~10-15 minutes. I’ll update when p99 < 800ms."
Sasha: small-wave of cold tokens still draining; proposing to prewarm a few sidecar replicas to warm KV for top hotkeys — can do a quick scale to +3 replicas in the eu worker pool
Raj: prewarm +3 started (scale job id scale-441). also enabling aggressive KV warm policy for those keys for 5m
Maya: good improvement: p99 at 680ms now, p95 steady ~180ms. KV hit ~94%
Alex: nice. marking PD incident PD-8742 as acknowledged -> partial-mitigation. leaving thread open for 20m to watch regressions. if anything flares, re-page. :thumbsup:
Tony: posted update to customer and flagged SRE status page entry.
Maya: follow-up: will run a heatmap of request seq lengths later to tune batching heuristics — seems correlated to sudden long-seq bursts
Raj: will follow up with a small routing rule to split long sequences into dedicated lanes to avoid head-of-line blocking
Alex: thanks all — good coordination. end of immediate action.
